content.title: What's Nick Viall's Net Worth And How Much Does 'Age Of Attraction' Host Make From His Podcast?
content.text: Bachelor universe star Nick Viall, the host of the new Netflix series Age Of Attraction, a show about people with wide age gaps dating each other. As the show dropped on Wednesday, fans are eager to see how the show will unfold and how Viall will lead the project. The 45-year-old TV star finished as runner-up in two seasons of The Bachelorette, according to Deadline. Age of Attraction presents a very relatable theme for Viall, who is married to his 27-year-old wife, Natalie Joy. Rebecca Quinn, who created the show with Jennifer O’Connell, said the show aims to normalize age gap couples. “You can go two ways with this kind of show,” Quinn told Deadline. “You can make it where you’re poking fun at age gaps and you’re judging them, and it’s like, ‘Oh my God, I can’t believe that young girls with an old guy, or you can make more of like an earnest love story. We’re celebrating it.” How much money does Nick Viall make from his podcast? Viall will host the Netflix dating series while growing his immensely popular podcast, The Viall Files, with his wife. Speaking with Bustle in 2025, Viall said his wife “brings an element of coolness” to the podcast. “I really respect her taste. She knows what’s trendy,” Viall told Bustle at the time. “I’m definitely the friend who’s going to give you the tough advice — the big brother, so to speak. But I feel like Natalie’s a person I want to hang out with.” According to Like & Subscribe on Substack, Viall earns $30 million from his podcast. What is Nick Viall’s net worth? Before Viall emerged as a TV star, he worked as a software sales executive. The Milwaukee native starred on multiple seasons of The Bachelorette and Bachelor in Paradise. Afterward, he landed a starring role in season 21 of The Bachelor. Between his successful podcast and his new hosting gig, Viall now holds an estimated net worth of $30 million, Just Jared reported.
